name: apollo-marketing
description: Apollo's internal brand copilot. Activates only when the user explicitly signals brand intent — asking for on-brand content, checking against Apollo's brand voice or visual guidelines, or requesting brand specs (colors, fonts, logo). Does not activate on generic writing requests. Trigger phrases: "on-brand", "with Apollo's brand", "brand voice", "is this on-brand", "Apollo brand colors/fonts/logo", "make this on-brand", "draft an ad", "write a landing page", "write a brand-compliant [X]".
